$comment: The work store's vocabulary and the triage numbers. titleChars: the longest title; textChars: the longest description, design, acceptance criteria, write scope, labels in all, notes in all, or comment. commentsShown: how many of the newest comments `show` gives; commentsMost: the most a `comments` call gives. leaseMinutes: how long a claim by a seat of the room lasts; the minute's sweep pushes it on while the app lists the seat, so it lapses about that long after the seat is gone. leaseDownHours: how long a seat the app shows closed or failed keeps its claims; a seat that long down is treated as gone, though a message would start it again; one still opening after leaseMinutes is treated as gone too. leaseMostPerPass: the most issues one pass gives back to the board. A dependency type with orders may close no cycle. Score: impactShare of the weighted factors (weights sum to 1), plus unblockBoost for what closing frees, plus readyBoost; betweenness is sampled above exactBetweennessUpTo. overlapsShown: the most colliding pairs a plan lists, those sharing most paths first; the plan counts the rest.
